Reading time calculator

How long will this book take you? Enter the number of pages, and the calculator estimates the hours and how many days it takes at your daily reading time.

Total reading time
Days to finish
Same book as a summary
TL;DR
  • Average adult silent reading is around 200–300 words a minute; 250 is the default.
  • A typical page holds about 250–300 words.
  • Compare with a 15–20 minute summary to decide what to read in full.

How the estimate works

The calculator multiplies pages by words per page, divides by your reading speed to get minutes, then divides by the minutes you read each day. Real reading time varies with the book: dense nonfiction, notes and rereading slow you down, while easy fiction speeds you up. Treat the result as a planning number, not a promise.

Not sure of your speed? Read for exactly two minutes, count the words (or lines × average words per line) and divide by two.

Questions people ask

How long does it take to read a 300-page book?

At about 250 words per page and 250 words per minute, a 300-page book takes roughly five hours of reading. At 30 minutes a day that is about ten days, and at 15 minutes a day around three weeks. Dense nonfiction or taking notes can add an hour or two.

What is an average reading speed?

Studies of adult silent reading in English usually land around 200 to 300 words per minute for normal texts, with 238 often quoted as an average for nonfiction. Speed drops for difficult material and rises for easy fiction. Comprehension matters more than speed, so measure your own pace on a typical book.

Is a book summary enough instead of the full book?

For deciding whether a book is worth your time, or refreshing one you already read, a 15 to 20 minute summary is often enough. For books you want to apply deeply, argue about or enjoy for their story, read the full book. Many readers use summaries to choose and full books to go deep.
